stem.text: Which reaction mechanism for the formation of $\text{C}_2\text{H}_5\text{CH(OH)(CN)}$ is correct?

A.alt: Reaction mechanism A for C2H5CH(OH)CN: three drawn steps with curly arrows, CN- attacking the carbonyl carbon, then O- taking H+, giving the cyanohydrin

B.alt: Reaction mechanism B for C2H5CH(OH)CN: three drawn steps with curly arrows, CN- attacking the carbonyl carbon, then O- taking H+, giving the cyanohydrin

C.alt: Reaction mechanism C for C2H5CH(OH)CN: three drawn steps with curly arrows, CN- attacking the carbonyl carbon, then O- taking H+, giving the cyanohydrin
